title: 차라도 주세요, 우산마저 없어요: 이라도·이나마·마저·까지
objective: By the end, you can choose between 이라도, 이나마, 마저, and 까지 by situation, attach each to a noun in the right form, and use them in everyday sentences.
summary: Learn four particles for second-best choices (이라도), making do with something small (이나마), and adding an extreme or final case (마저, 까지).

task.title: Choose and use particles
task.line: Read each situation, then choose, fill in, or write the particle that fits best.

forms.form: N + 이라도 (after a consonant) / 라도 (after a vowel)
forms.when: Your first choice is not possible, so you pick another option. It is often used in requests and suggestions.
forms.means: at least ~ / ~ instead (not the best, but it's OK)
forms.exampleMeaning: If you're out of coffee, I'll have tea instead.

forms.form: N + 이나마 (after a consonant) / 나마 (after a vowel)
forms.when: Something is small or not enough, but you accept it gladly. It is a bit formal and is often used to show thanks or modesty.
forms.means: even though it's only ~ / small as it is
forms.example: 짧은 휴가나마 푹 쉴 수 있어서 좋았어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: It was a short vacation, but I'm glad I could get a good rest.

forms.form: N + 마저 (same after a consonant or vowel)
forms.when: Something bad happens, and then even the last thing you were counting on is gone or goes wrong. It is used mostly for bad situations.
forms.exampleMeaning: It was raining, and on top of that I even lost my umbrella.

forms.form: N + 까지 (same after a consonant or vowel)
forms.when: One more thing is added, beyond what you expected. It works for both good and bad situations. Here 까지 does not mean 'until'.
forms.example: 친구가 밥도 사 주고 선물까지 줬어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: My friend bought me a meal and even gave me a present.

watchOut: 물라도 (X) → 물이라도 (O): 물 ends in a consonant, so use 이라도. The same rule goes for 이나마/나마.
동생이 선물마저 줬어요 (X) → 동생이 선물까지 줬어요 (O): for a good surprise, use 까지. 마저 is used for bad situations.
버스가 끊겼으면 택시나마 타세요 (X) → 버스가 끊겼으면 택시라도 타세요 (O): to suggest another option, use 이라도/라도, not 이나마.
exercises: Choose the right particle: ① 시간이 없으면 김밥(이라도 / 마저) 먹고 가세요. ② 회사 일이 바쁜데 동료(라도 / 마저) 그만뒀어요.
Fill in the blank with 이라도 or 라도: ① 주스가 없으면 우유____ 주세요. ② 직접 못 오면 메일____ 보내 주세요.
Choose 마저 or 까지. If both fit, write both: ① 이사를 도와준 친구가 저녁(마저 / 까지) 사 줬어요. ② 열이 나는데 약(마저 / 까지) 다 떨어졌어요.
Fill in the blank with 이나마 or 나마: ① 짧은 편지____ 마음을 담아 썼어요. ② 작은 힘____ 보태고 싶어요.
Answer in Korean: Your friend says, "배고픈데 식당이 다 문을 닫았어." Suggest eating ramyeon at a convenience store. Use 편의점 and 라면.
Join the two sentences into one with 마저: 오늘 아침에 늦게 일어났어요. / 버스도 놓쳤어요.
answers: ① 까지 (저녁까지) ② 마저, 까지 (약마저 / 약까지: both fit)
편의점에서 라면이라도 먹자. (편의점에서 라면이라도 먹을까? / 편의점에서 라면이라도 먹어요.)
오늘 아침에 늦게 일어났는데 버스마저 놓쳤어요. (늦게 일어나서 버스마저 놓쳤어요.)
